title: Lower bounds for derived scalar extension from finite upper truncations
statement: Let C be a site essentially small in the coefficient universe, R → S a morphism of commutative ring sheaves, E the additive scalar-extension functor specified on objects and maps, and F a functor between their derived categories. Suppose F(Q(P)) is isomorphic to Q(E(P)) for every K-flat complex P [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For a complex G and an integer a, if F(Q(τ≤b G)) lies in degrees ≥a for every integer b [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], then F(Q(G)) lies in degrees ≥a. Module categories and K-flatness are those of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and [lem-pc-kflat-resolution].

proof.text: Use the reduced functorial categorical flat resolution exported from the existing independent-coefficient resolution module. Its resolutionFunctor at G is the integer-indexed colimit of the bounded resolutions of G.truncLE b, and its augmentation to G is a quasi-isomorphism. The bounded stages and their colimit are K-flat by the existing generic left-resolution API.

source.place: Tag 077J; sites-modules.tex Tags 03DB and 03EP. Agent consequence via the library functorial flat-resolution construction.

proof.text: The specified ordinary scalar-extension functor preserves colimits by its tensor/restriction adjunction. Apply the K-flat computation isomorphism at each bounded stage and transport the assumed lower bound along its quasi-isomorphism to the upper truncation. Exact filtered colimits preserve the exact short complexes in degrees below a; the private lower_bound_colimit proof checks this with the evaluation functors and colim.exact_mapShortComplex. Therefore E of the colimit has the same lower bound.

proof.text: Apply the supplied K-flat computation at the colimit resolution and transport along its augmentation to G. This gives the required lower bound, with no boundedness on G and no Tor condition needed in this continuity statement.

theorem derivedScalar_lower_bound_of_truncations
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [EssentiallySmall.{r} C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{r}]
    {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{r}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S))]
    (E : SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S))
    (hobj : ∀ N, E.obj N = changeOfRings.{v, u, r} φ N)
    (hmap : ∀ {N N'} (f : N ⟶ N'), E.map f = eqToHom (hobj N) ≫
      changeOfRingsHom.{v, u, r} φ N f ≫ eqToHom (hobj N').symm)
    [E.Additive]
    (F : DerivedCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S)))
    (hcompute : ∀ P : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ,
      P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
        Nonempty (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    (G : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ)
    (a : ℤ)
    (hfinite : ∀ b : ℤ, (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (G.truncLE b))).IsGE a) :
    (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)).IsGE a
